(i) the reflection component is stronger in mildly absorbed AGN, and the reflection geometry changes from an accretion disc to a torus-like structure when absorption is higher, (ii) there are correlations between the reflection and the Fe Kα emission line, (iii) we find a positive correlation between the reflection and absorption, and (iv) there is a positive correlation between absorption and the Fe K emission line.
the reflection behaviour varies with absorption and that the accretion disc, and probably the broad line region, seems to be the major contributor of the reflection in unabsorped AGN.
